messages.subject: Campus Drive: Northwind Systems - Software Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Northwind Systems is visiting campus for the Software Engineer role (CTC 12 LPA).
Eligibility: B.Tech CSE, IT, ECE | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs | 2026 batch only.
Register here: https://forms.gle/northwindSDE by 11:59 PM, 20 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office
